title: 1575 Valdivia earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1575 Valdivia earthquake", at revision 1367032455, opens: "The 1575 Valdivia earthquake occurred at 14:30 local time on December 16. It had an estimated magnitude of 8.5 of on the surface-wave magnitude scale and an estimated magnitude of 9.0+ on the Moment magnitude scale and led to the flood of Valdivia, Chile." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1348911, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "earthquake in Chile". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
